Home.heroSubtitle: Premium furniture, FF&E procurement, interior design, and project management for luxury spaces worldwide.
Home.philosophyText: GENESI is your partner for high-end interior solutions. From bespoke furniture to complete turnkey contract management, we bring Italian design excellence to hotels, residences, and commercial spaces. Every detail is meticulously engineered to ensure timeless elegance.
Home.turnkeyText: We provide comprehensive FF&E procurement, custom millwork, and project management. From the initial concept to the final white-glove installation, Genesi ensures impeccable execution.

About.heroSubtitle: Rooted in the timeless tradition of Italian craftsmanship, GENESI redefines luxury living through innovative design and impeccable execution.
About.storyP1: Since our inception, GENESI has been driven by a singular vision: to create environments that inspire. We believe that true luxury lies in the harmony between aesthetics and functionality, where every line, every material, and every finish tells a story.
About.storyP2: Our approach combines the soul of artisan craftsmanship with the precision of modern engineering. From our headquarters in Milan, we curate collections and orchestrate bespoke contract projects for the world's most demanding clients.
About.statMadeInItalyDesc: Sourced, crafted, and finished entirely in Italy by master artisans.
About.statGlobalProjectsDesc: Delivering turnkey FF&E solutions across five continents.
About.statBespokeOptionsDesc: Infinite customization possibilities to meet any architectural vision.

Studio.heroSubtitle: Our internal creative hub where architecture, interior design, and product engineering converge.
Studio.hubP1: GENESI Studio is the beating heart of our brand. Composed of architects, interior designers, and master engineers, the studio is responsible for the conception of our collections and the execution of our turnkey contract projects.
Studio.hubP2: By maintaining a seamless dialogue between the drawing board and the production floor, we ensure that every design is not only conceptually striking but also structurally impeccable and perfectly tailored to the client's needs.
Studio.quote: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works within the space.

Services.headerSubtitle: From concept engineering to flawless execution, GENESI offers a comprehensive suite of services tailored for the most demanding luxury projects worldwide.
Services.readySubtitle: Our team of contract specialists is ready to review your architectural plans and provide a comprehensive quotation.
Services.s01Desc: Every space is unique, and so are its requirements. Our master artisans and in-house design team collaborate closely with architects to customize our collections or engineer completely bespoke pieces from scratch, ensuring perfect integration into your architectural vision.
Services.s02Desc: We manage the complexities of global luxury procurement. From selecting the finest Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment to managing vendor relations and quality control, GENESI acts as your single point of contact for outfitting world-class hospitality and residential projects.
Services.s03Desc: Our turnkey service provides peace of mind for large-scale developments. We oversee the entire lifecycle of the interior outfitting process, transforming bare architectural shells into fully operational, breathtaking environments, delivered on time and flawlessly executed.
Services.s04Desc: The final touch of luxury. Our dedicated logistics team ensures that every piece of furniture is transported under the strictest safety conditions and installed on-site by our specialized technicians with meticulous care and precision.

Catalogue.title: Our Collections
Catalogue.subtitle: Explore our curated selection of premium furniture across all categories.
Catalogue.noProducts: No products currently available in this collection.

Projects.headerSubtitle: A selection of our most prestigious contract and residential projects worldwide. GENESI partners with renowned architects to deliver uncompromising quality in every space.

Materials.headerSubtitle: The essence of true luxury lies in what you can feel. At GENESI, we obsess over every surface, sourcing only the most exquisite materials to craft masterpieces that stand the test of time.
Materials.sampleSubtitle: Architects and interior designers can request our exclusive Materials Box to experience the GENESI quality firsthand.
Materials.marblesDesc: Sourced from the finest quarries in Carrara and around the world, our marbles offer unparalleled unique veining and timeless elegance. Each slab is hand-selected by our master artisans.
Materials.woodsDesc: We use only sustainably sourced, premium timber. Our veneers are carefully book-matched to create seamless, continuous grain patterns that celebrate the natural beauty of the wood.
Materials.metalsDesc: Our metal components undergo rigorous galvanic treatments to achieve flawless, durable finishes that range from warm, brushed brass to sleek, polished chrome.
Materials.leathersDesc: Working exclusively with top-tier Italian tanneries, we offer full-grain leathers and nabuk that age beautifully, providing unparalleled softness and durability.

Contact.headerSubtitle: Whether you are inquiring about a specific collection, requesting a bespoke piece, or proposing a large-scale hospitality project, our team is at your disposal.
